_note: Each fixture is the clean control with exactly one planted defect. The named gate must be among the gates that reject it. Regenerate with python3 tests/negative/build-fixtures.py

01--section-out-of-order.md.defect: Confidence is reported before the null model, so the contract's order is broken while every required heading is still present.

02--two-primary-causes.md.defect: The primary cause is hedged into two causes mid-sentence, which is the shape a flat audit takes when it is wearing a diagnosis's headings.

03--levels-collapsed.md.defect: The mechanism is restated as a label instead of traced to this listing's evidence, collapsing three levels into two.

04--fabricated-quote.md.defect: A plausible showing-feedback quote that appears nowhere in the case input is planted mid-paragraph, between two quotes that are real.

05--invented-figure.md.defect: A comp baseline figure the case never supplied is written mid-sentence into the evidence section, where it reads as measured.

06--rival-without-evidence.md.defect: A rival is named and demoted with no eliminating evidence attached, which is a list of dismissals wearing the demotion section's name.

07--no-integrity-verdict.md.defect: The integrity section discusses the comparison set at length but never states the verdict, so a weak baseline would pass without anyone noticing it was never graded.

08--prescription-midsentence.md.defect: A recommended action is buried mid-paragraph in the missing-evidence section, far from the start of any line, in the hedged form rules.md names explicitly.

09--no-confidence-level.md.defect: The confidence section reads as confident prose mid-paragraph but never states one of the three permitted levels, so nothing binds the cap.
